sources.title: NCES Handbook of Survey Methods, IPEDS
sources.evidence: OPEID suffixes A1, A2 and similar identify entities separately in IPEDS for reporting.

sources.title: IPEDS Completions 1998 documentation
sources.evidence: OPEID suffix A1 through A9 represents an eligible main campus branch represented in IPEDS but not separately in PEPS.

recommendation: Store IPEDS source OPEID as nullable string preserving numeric8 and alpha branch identifiers. Map -2 to missing with reason. If exposing an FSA-compatible numeric8 identifier, give alphanumeric branches a distinct not_comparable_exact_fsa_id status, never strip the suffix or invent 00.
